claims.text: The Tongan text of Gazette No. 19 (Kasete 'a e Pule'anga Tonga, Fika 19, Monite 11 Sepitema 2006) carries the FANONGONONGO in the name of SIAOSI TUPOU V, Tu'i 'o e 'Otu Tonga, by Premier Feleti Vaka'uta Sevele. It states that at the death (hala) of Taufa'ahau Tupou IV the Crown of Tonga passed to Crown Prince Tupouto'a, proclaims that he has become the rightful King (Tu'i totonu), and is signed at Nuku'alofa on 11 September 2006 by Ma'afu, Kalake ki he Fakataha Tokoni.
claims.locator: Reproduced gazette header, FANONGONONGO and sign-off; article timestamp Sep 11, 2006, 18:40
claims.uncertainty: A summary of the Tongan text, not an official translation. It corroborates the English proclamation (to_crown_gtv_devolution_proclamation_20060911) and, like it, gives no date or time of death. PMO web reproduction, not the gazette facsimile.
